scripts.build:resume: md-to-pdf content/resume.md --config-file md-to-pdf.json --stylesheet src/styles/print-resume.css --body-class=resume --basedir . && mv content/resume.pdf _site/resume-osmarpetry.pdf
scripts.build: npm run build:site && npm run build:resume && node scripts/size-check.mjs
scripts.test:cypress: npm run build && npm run test:serve
scripts.test:serve: concurrently "npm run dev" "npm run test:run" --kill-others --success first
scripts.test:ci: npm run build && start-server-and-test dev http://localhost:8080 'cypress run'
